## About
CS & FinTech B.Tech student at MIT (started 2023, SAT 1440, CGPA 7.16).
Languages: Python, TypeScript, Swift, Java, C, C++.
Web: Next.js, React, Spring Boot, Tailwind.
Native/Systems: SwiftUI, AppKit, Linux, PipeWire, Docker.
Other: Blender, Unity, Blockchain, CTF / Security.
Timeline:
- 2026: PaperCache (reactive markdown notebook, 8 stars), Omelette (OpenRouter extension for Raycast/Vicinae), Vinyl (macOS menu bar lyrics app in Swift)
- 2025: DRDO requisition platform intern, IIT Indore EVM/smart-contract research, PipeWire audio splitter, General Secretary PRISM
- 2024: Design Head (100+ designers, Finova/MIST), organised KernelCTF/AuroraCTF/IndomitusCTF, Python blockchain P2P, ML network intrusion detection
- 2023: Started B.Tech MIT
- 2021: 3D modelling / prop making (Blender, CAD, woodworking, origami)
- 2015: YouTube tech & gaming channel
